messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
User wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to produce a self-contained SVG drawing. Make it nice: bicycle wheels, frame, pelican body, big beak pouch, wing on handlebar, etc. Output just SVG code in a code block.

Let me design carefully with coordinates. Canvas 640x480.

Bicycle: rear wheel center (170, 350) r=70; front wheel center (460, 350) r=70. Frame: bottom bracket (315, 350); seat tube up to (275, 250); down tube from bottom bracket to head tube (420, 265); top tube from (275,255) to (410, 260); chain stay from (315,350) to (170,350); seat stay from (275,255) to (170,350); fork from head tube (420,265) to front hub (460,350); handlebar from (420,265) up to (425, 235) then bar.

Pelican sits on saddle at (270, 240). Body oval centered around (300, 200)? Pelican body resting on saddle, leaning forward, neck extending forward-up to head near handlebar at (430, 175), long beak pointing right-down to (540, 200) with pouch.

Wings: one wing reaching forward to handlebar grip at (415, 235).

Legs: pelican feet on pedals. Pedals at crank around bottom bracket (315,350), crank radius 28: pedal positions (343, 330) and (287, 370). Legs from body lower (300, 240) down to pedals.

Tail feathers pointing back-left.

Let me craft detailed SVG with gradients, spokes, motion lines maybe. Keep it clean but charming.

Let me write spokes: generate with a loop manually? I'll write a set of lines via a group with rotate transforms around wheel center: 12 spokes per wheel using <g transform="rotate(...)">. Simpler: define a <g id="spokes"> with lines and use <use> with transforms. I'll just write explicit lines.

Spokes for wheel center (170,350): lines from center to rim at angles 0,30,...330. Easier: use a symbol "wheel" defined at origin, then use twice with translate. Yes: define <g id="wheel"> with circles and spokes at origin (0,0) r=70. Then <use href="#wheel" transform="translate(170,350)"/> and translate(460,350). Spokes as 8 lines: from (0,-64) to (0,64) rotated. Use <g> with 4 lines rotated at 0,45,90,135 covering 8 spokes, plus more at 22.5 etc. Fine.

Draw pelican behind bicycle partially? Layer order: background, rear wheel + front wheel, frame, pelican body (in front of frame partly), wing on handlebar, legs in front of crank, head/beak.

Colors: pelican white/cream body with grey wing accents, orange beak and pouch, pink feet. Sky gradient background, sun, clouds, ground.

Let me write the SVG.

Pelican body: an egg shape leaning forward: path M 240,235 C 235,185 275,155 320,165 C 360,175 375,210 355,240 C 335,265 265,268 240,235 Z. Something like that. Body center ~ (300, 205).

Neck: from body front-top (350,180) curving to head at (430,160). Neck path as thick stroke width 26, stroke-linecap round: M 345,190 C 380,165 400,150 425,155.

Head: ellipse cx=440 cy=155 rx=26 ry=22.

Beak: long, from head right side: top mandible from (462,148) to tip (560,170), pouch below from tip back to (455,178) bulging down to (505,205). Path: M 460,146 Q 520,150 566,168 Q 555,205 505,206 Q 470,200 452,178 Z — pouch orange, mandible lighter orange/yellow on top.

Actually draw pouch first (orange), then mandible as a shape overlapping top.

Mandible: M 458,144 Q 515,146 566,166 Q 540,168 495,166 Q 468,162 456,158 Z — hmm need a slender upper beak. Let's do: upper beak path: M 456,144 L 566,166 L 555,175 L 456,164 Z with slight curve. Use quadratic.

Pouch: M 456,162 Q 500,175 545,172 Q 540,208 495,206 Q 465,196 452,175 Z.

Eye at (446,150) r=4 with white highlight.

Crest feathers small on back of head.

Wing: from body (300,190) reaching to handlebar grip (418,232): wing shape path: M 290,185 C 330,175 380,195 412,225 C 400,240 350,235 310,225 C 292,218 284,200 290,185 Z with feather lines.

Legs: two legs from (295,250) to pedal (343,330): stroke width 8 orange; second leg to (287,370). Feet: little webbed shapes on pedals.

Tail: path behind body pointing left-up: M 245,220 L 200,205 L 210,232 L 190,232 L 232,248 Z. Hmm tail should be behind saddle/rear. Let's make tail feathers from (248,215) to (198,190) etc.

Saddle: at (272,248) small ellipse/path; pelican body sits on it. Draw saddle before body.

Handlebar: from head tube top (420,262) up to (416,236), then bar going left-right: line from (398,232) to (432,240)? Simpler: handlebar path M 418,265 C 416,245 414,238 410,232, plus crossbar from (392,234) to (436,236). Grips darker.

Also add chain: line from rear hub to bottom bracket crank, chain ring circle r=16 at (315,350), cog r=10 at rear hub. Chain lines top and bottom.

Motion: little speed lines behind, dust puffs.

Helmet on pelican? Cute — add a small helmet. Maybe yes: a yellow helmet arc on head. That adds charm.

Let me finalize code with gradients and reasonable structure.

Also add ground shadow ellipse.

Write out:

<svg viewBox="0 0 640 480" width="640" height="480" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="A pelican riding a bicycle">

defs: sky gradient, ground gradient, pouch gradient, wheel symbol.

Background: rect sky, sun circle, clouds, hills, road line.

Seatpost: line (272,255)->(268,238); saddle shape path at (268,235): M 244,238 Q 268,228 292,236 Q 288,246 262,246 Q 248,245 244,238 Z fill #4a4a4a.

Pelican body sits above saddle: body bottom around y=248. Good.

Crank: circle r=4 at BB; crank arms to pedals: (315,350)->(345,332) and ->(285,368). Pedal rectangles.

Chain: path from (170,340) to (315,334) and (170,360) to (315,366), stroke #555 width 3 dashed. Chainring circle r=17 at (315,350) fill none stroke; rear cog r=11.

Legs: pelican's legs from under body (300,246) to pedal (345,332): path M 300,246 C 318,275 330,300 342,330 stroke #f0a05a width 9 round. Other leg: M 288,248 C 285,290 280,335 286,366.

Feet: webbed foot shapes on pedals at (345,332) and (286,368): small triangles.

Speed lines: to left of pelican: lines at (120,170)-(160,175), etc. And dust near rear wheel.

Also maybe a small basket? No, keep clean.

Add caption text? Could add subtle text "Pelican Cycling" — maybe not needed but cute. I'll skip or add small. I'll skip text.

Now write full SVG carefully.

Head helmet: arc over head: path M 414,148 C 418,124 462,122 468,146 Z fill #f6c445 stroke, plus strap line to (438,168).

Let me check head position: head ellipse cx=440, cy=155, rx=27, ry=23 → top y=132. Helmet arc covering top from (415,146) to (468,148) with apex at y=120: path M 414,147 C 418,118 464,116 470,148 Z. Good.

Beak attaches at head right: head right edge x=467 at y=155. Beak upper from (458,146) to tip (570,166). Pouch from (455,168) bulging to (510,212).

Draw pouch: M 456,164 C 486,178 522,180 562,166 C 556,204 512,216 478,202 C 462,194 452,180 452,170 Z.

Upper mandible: M 452,146 C 500,148 540,156 568,164 C 560,172 520,174 484,170 C 466,167 452,160 450,152 Z fill #f2a93b with stroke.

Maybe simpler: draw whole beak as pouch orange, then upper mandible as lighter shape on top. Fine.

Eye: circle (442,148) r=4.5 fill #2b2b2b; highlight (443.5,146.5) r=1.6 white.

Small crest: path M 414,142 C 400,132 402,146 410,150 stroke.

Wing reaching handlebar: pelican's wing as arm. Wing path from body: M 288,196 C 322,178 372,196 402,224 C 392,240 344,238 306,226 C 288,220 280,206 288,196 Z fill #e8eef2 stroke #b9c7cf. Feather lines: three curves inside.

Wing "hand"/wingtip near grip (404,230).

Body fill cream #fdf6ea with stroke #d9c9b3. Also belly shading.

Neck: stroke path from (340,200) to (424,160), width 30, color cream, plus outline? Strokes don't have separate outline easily; use path fill instead. Alternative: draw neck as filled path: 
M 330,222 C 344,190 372,160 414,142 L 434,166 C 396,178 372,200 356,232 Z roughly. Let me construct: neck connects body front-top to head. Body front top around (348,178). Head at (440,155). Neck filled path:
M 336,214 C 348,178 376,150 416,136 C 432,140 442,148 444,158 C 416,164 386,184 368,222 Z
Hmm messy. Simpler approach: draw neck as thick stroke with cream color, then body drawn over the lower part, head over upper part — outline issue: I can draw a slightly darker thick stroke first (width 34, color #d9c9b3) then cream stroke (width 28) on top. That yields outline effect. Good trick.

Same for legs: darker stroke then orange? Just orange stroke fine.

Order:
1. bg
2. shadow
3. wheels (use)
4. chain, chainring, cog
5. frame
6. saddle
7. pelican tail
8. pelican body (with belly)
9. neck (outline+fill)
10. head + beak + pouch + eye + helmet
11. wing (over frame/handlebar)
12. handlebar drawn before wing? Handlebar under wingtip: draw handlebar in frame group, then wing over it. Grip drawn before wing.
13. legs + feet + crank + pedals (legs over frame/crank), pedals over feet? Feet on pedals: draw pedal then foot on top? Draw crank+pedal behind, then legs and feet.

Also near crank: pelican feet on pedals, legs in front.

Ok write it.

Add small details: bell on handlebar, motion sparkles.

Ground: rect from y=420 to 480 with gradient; wheels bottom at y=420. Good: wheel center 350 r 70 → bottom 420. 

Let me write final code.

Clouds: ellipse groups white opacity .85.

Hills: path fill #a8cfa3.

Sun at (90,80) r=34 with rays? just circle + halo.

Speed lines: at left: M 96,300 h 44 stroke #7fb6c9 width 5 round, etc. Place behind pelican but in front of bg; place them before wheels? Draw as part of bg decoration.

Also add a small "swoosh" near beak tip.

Final output: code block with SVG. Include a brief intro line? The user asked "Generate an SVG" — provide code block, maybe one sentence. Keep concise.
